records.purpose: Copy the running game build identity into out (caller sets out->size): the exe's PE TimeDateStamp and SizeOfImage, the game pack version triple, the four-part build the pack verified, that build's PE timestamp, and pin_matches (1 when the running timestamp equals the verified one). Constant for the process lifetime; no engine state is read beyond the module header.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*read)(sco_plugin* self, sc_game_build_info* out);`
Copy the running game build identity into out (caller sets out->size): the exe's PE TimeDateStamp and SizeOfImage, the game pack version triple, the four-part build the pack verified, that build's PE timestamp, and pin_matches (1 when the running timestamp equals the verified one). Constant for the process lifetime; no engine state is read beyond the module header.
records.ownership: All values copied from constants and the module header; provider retains nothing, allocates nothing.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only (published with the game pack).
records.results: OK identity copied, UNAVAILABLE out null or out->size too small, BAD_ARG invalid self.
records.absent_capability: game.build.info publishes with the game pack; if the module header is unreadable the service does not publish at all.
records.cleanup: StopGameBuild withdraws the service; no state to restore.
limitations: String form of the verified build lives in sc_game_pack.h; the service exposes the numeric mirrors and refuses to start when the mirrors disagree.
No game manifest fields (branch, changelist) cross the ABI in 1.0.
No C# or Lua game.build routes are supported.
